headline: Last session: Indian benchmark indices fell as markets remain closed today for Gandhi Jayanti holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today, 2 October 2026, for Gandhi Jayanti.
In the last session, markets dropped sharply due to heavy selling by foreign institutional investors.
Rising crude oil prices and global interest rate hike concerns triggered market outflows.
The US Trade Representative indicated that no trade agreement with India is imminent.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty recorded losses, extending their weekly loss streak.
Foreign investors wiped out significant market capitalization through en-masse selling.
Bajaj Finance announced capital raising plans worth Rs 17,500 crore via QIP and preferential issue.
Regular market trading will reopen on Monday, 5 October 2026.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the Gandhi Jayanti holiday.
On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty experienced steep declines driven by sustained foreign capital outflows.
Trading will resume on Monday, 5 October 2026.
